reason: Everything in my salon already runs on WhatsApp on my one phone and it works well enough. During rush hours my girls won't stop to take selfies and type numbers into an app, so in two weeks it will be lying unused and I'll still be paying ₹999 a month.
objection: My staff are busy with customers; they won't type everything into an app, and it's in English, so half of them will keep asking me how to use it.
would_change_my_mind: If another salon owner near me showed me their staff really using it for a few months and it caught cash missing from the drawer, and I could try it with no setup fee before paying anything.
